articles.title: Wizards Sign Reece Beekman, Trevor Keels, Chris Livingston, Steve Settle III To Camp Deals; Waive KeShawn Murphy
articles.description: The Washington Wizards signed a quartet of players to Exhibit 10 contracts. Washington signed guards Reece Beekman and Trevor Keels, wing Chris Livingston and forward Steve Settle III. The Wizards also waived forward KeShawn Murphy, who was signed to an Exhibit 10 contract last week. Beekman played in 48 G League games for the Osceola Magic last season. The 6-foot-3 guard averaged 10 points, 4.0 rebounds, 6.2 assists and 2.0 steals per game. Keels spent part of last season on a two-way contract with the Miami Heat. In 40 G League games with the Sioux Falls Skyforce, the 6-foot-3 guard averaged 18.7 points, 3.4 rebounds, 3.2 assists and 1.2 steals per game. Livingston played in 32 total G League games split between the Cleveland Charge and the Capital City Go-Go last season. The 6-foot-6 wing averaged 18.2 points, 6.6 points and 2.0 assists per game. Settle played in 46 G League games with the Sioux Falls Skyforce last season. The 6-foot-10 forward averaged 7.4 points and 3.5 rebounds last season. Following the NBA preseason, Beekman, Keels, Livingston, Settle and Murphy are all expected to join the Capital City Go-Go for the upcoming G League season.

articles.title: Knicks Sign N'Faly Dante To Exhibit 10 Contract
articles.description: The New York Knicks signed big man N'Faly Dante to an Exhibit 10 contract. Dante will join a group competing for a roster spot. The 6-foot-11 forward/center is eligible to have his deal converted to a two-way contract. Dante tore his right ACL in late December last season. Prior to that, he had appeared in four games for the Atlanta Hawks. Dante was later waived in order for Atlanta to create a roster spot to complete trade deadline moves. In the G League, Dante has proven to be a good finisher around the rim, solid rebounder and strong rim protector. The Knicks still have all three of their two-way spots open, as well as two standard spots on their regular season roster.
